The clinic offers supervision services for poultry farms, comprehensive examinations, vaccinations, and high-quality pet supplies, combining medical expertise with providing all necessary supplies and services needed by breeders and pet owners. FAQ:
What veterinary services does Dr. Nada Hassan provide?
A: Dr. Nada Hassan Ali Hashem provides veterinary supervision services for poultry farms, comprehensive examination of pets, vaccinations for cats and dogs, reservation of chicks, and provision of all farm supplies, pet food and accessories.
Does Zad Veterinary Clinic provide supervision services and poultry farm supplies?
A: Yes, Dr. Nada Hassan specializes in the field of poultry and provides medical supervision of flocks, reservation of chicks, and provision of farm equipment and supplies such as waterers and feeders.
